name: genomicschain_tier2
description: GenomicsChain Tier-2, the code-reading tier. gc_tier2_scan reads a workflow repository's declared software, container and data resources and classifies how strongly each is pinned; gc_tier2_adjudicate reads a Tier-1 report against that scan, assigns env_capture_class A/B/C and proposes the rubric's per-step caps. Reads only — never evaluates a workflow.
author: Masaomi Hatakeyama
